tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// byad 'grol gser gyi lde mig gi lag len gsal byed nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa bklag pas don 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo badz+ra dhā ra ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse dang*// nus pa'i rang gzugs rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// bka' drin mtshungs med gter chen chos kyi rje// byang chub bar du gtsug gi pad+mor mchod// 'dir byad 'grol gyi cho ga bya bar 'dod pas yo byad bshams pa dang bum pa sgrub pa sogs sgrub thabs snying po gsal ba bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ gzhan don du byad 'grol gyi las sbyor sgrub par byed pa la/ rang gi mdun du bsgrub bya re nag gru gsum gyi khar bzhag /tshon skud kyis bcing*/ sāts+tsha mgo bor bkod la 'di skad brjod par bya'o// 'o 'dir byad 'grol ba'i rim pa sgrub par byed pa la thog mar lo rgyus kyis nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ cho ga dngos gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ rig 'dzin rje'i chog khrigs las/ byad kyi rtags rnams yong tshul dang*// gdams par yid ches khungs btsun brgyud// byad 'grol byas pa'i phan yon bshad// ces gsungs pa'i/ dang po rtags ni gzhung las/ de yang rang la gzhan gyis ngag mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang: bsdams pa dang: mthu byas pa'i rtags su: lces lab mi shes par skrangs pa dang: lkog ma dang mgul pa 'gags nas na ba dang: sngags bgrang mi shes pa dang: bgrang yang sgra mi dag pa dang: lce yi mdog 'gyur ba dang: rgya gram du gas pa dang: kha bcings par rmi ba dang: lce la phur pa btab pa rmi ba dang: chos po ti'i 'og dang mchod rten gyi 'og tu non pa dang: dong gting ring du tshud pa dang: re ba nag pos btums pa rmi ba dang: mun pa nag po'i phugs su tshud pa dang: brag phug stong pa dang: khang stong dang yul stong rmi ba dang: gcig nas gcig tu 'dzul ba rmi ba dang*/ khang stong rdib la khad pa'i nang du phyin pa rmi ba dang: zam pa dang lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du nyal ba rmi ba dang*/ ri rong dog po'i rtse nas rbab tu lhung la khad pa dang: lhung ba rmi ba dang:

lha khang dang lder bzo rmi ba dang: dngos su'ang rang nyams shed chung ba dang: sngags bzla snying mi 'dod pa dang: bzlas kyang ldab ldib tu song ba dang: sgrub pa byas kyang nus pa chung la bar chad mang ba dang: rang khro zhing 'tshig pa za ba dang: snying mi dga' ba dang: bskyed rim mi gsal ba dang: lus lci zhing 'thibs pa dang: gos mi gtsang ba gyon pa dang: mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab tu phyin pa rmi ba dang: ro khur gyi gling du phyin pa dang: nad pa skyugs log rmi ba dang: mtsho dang chu mig rlan rlon gyi 'dam du bying ba dang phyin pa rmi ba dang: grog po chen po'i 'og tu tshud pa dang: khyer la khad pa dang: ri nyil ba dang: brag phug gting ring du 'dzul ba rmi ba dang: dngos su 'ang shes pa gnad du mi phebs par yed yed pa dang: de ltar byung na lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa dang bsdams pa'i rtags so: rang la gzhan gyis mthu byas pa'i rtags su: don med par snying mi dga' ba dang: mi la 'thab 'dod pa dang: ca co 'bog snying 'dod pa dang: nang du 'thab mo mang ba dang: rmi lam du mi ngo mi shes pa dang: mon pa dang a tsa ras rang la brgyab pa dang 'thab pa dang: rdo'i char 'bab pa dang thog 'bab pa dang: mda' dang mdung dang gri brgyab pa rmi ba dang: rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang: ri gzar nas rdo rbab byung ba dang: dmag gis bskor ba rmis na mthu byas pa'i rtags so: dmag mang po dang ban+de dang sngags bon gyi dmag gis bskor ba rmi ba dang: gcan zan dang bya nag gis ded pa rmi ba dang: dngos su rang gi gos la gris rma byung ba dang: ltas ngan gyi sems can byung ba dang: bud med dang mi mang pos mdzo dang rta dang bong drel la sga stong gtad nas rang la sgo nyal byed pa rmi ba dang: rtags de rnams tshur rang la byung na mis rang la byas pa'i rtags te: de rnams ni mthu byad yod pa'i rtags so: zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa lo rgyus ni/ gzhung las/ sngon rgya gar gyi yul du las kyi mkha' 'gros mdzad de:

rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la sbas so: rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po byon nas tshogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing yod tsa na: mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung nas rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kyi mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la gsang sngags thams cad kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba dang: man ngag mkhan rnams kyi nus pa med par bya ba dang: rang gi nus pa thams cad mchog tu skyed pa'i gdams pa yod do: zhes lung bstan byung nas: der slob dpon gyis gzigs pas: byang phyogs kyi mchod rten de'i khri 'phang la me stag dmar phrom phrom 'dug pa gzigs nas: der mkha' 'gro la gtor ma phul nas: de nas gzong gis g.yeng bas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig byung ngo: de bshigs pa'i nang nas gsang ba'i man ngag gsang sngags thams cad kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba'i man ngag: nus pa thams cad mchog tu skyed pa'i man ngag 'di byung ngo: der slob dpon thugs dgyes nas mkha' 'gro rnams la gtor tshogs rgya chen po phul lo: slob dpon khrag 'thung nag pos gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ngo: de nas rim par drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa ni gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus so// gsum pa phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ de ltar byas pas ban bon sngags pa mu stegs 'bum gyi mthu gtad sel 'bum/ phra men gyi ngan sbyor 'gong chog ngan sngags kyis rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa dang kha rje dbang thang zad par byas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la grol te yon tan dang phan yon dpag tu med do: rang gi chos skyong gi rten la gtor na rang gi srung ma bdud du babs pa dang gshed du babs pa las grol bar 'gyur ro: zhing la gtor na zhing sel byas pa thams cad grol: khang pa la gtor na khang sel gyis mi tshugs: sngags rnams rin po ches bris rdza'i gwa'ur bcug nas khang pa dang zhing la sbas na bkra shis shing:

ye shes dang srung ma ngang gis 'du 'o: mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che: bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro: 'di nyid rdzong dang khang pa dang gnas gzhi gang du byas pa der: khang sel khang gtad mthu byad mnan gtad khram gsum gyis mi tshugs te gnas khang bkra shis la byin che: lha dang srung ma 'du 'o: zhing la zhing gtad zhing sel ngan byed gnod pas mi tshugs shing: btsa' sad 'bu srin gyis mi tshugs lo legs par 'gyur ro: rnal 'byor pa rang dang dpon slob gang yod pa thams cad kyi mthu byad mnan gtad khram gsum gyi ngan sbyor thams cad nyi mas ba mo zhu ba ltar 'gyur ba dang: sdig sgrib dag: rig pa dwangs: bskyed rim gsal: dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel: bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: de la sogs pa phan yon bgrangs las 'das so: de bzhin du ri la gtor na ri pra ngan pa thams cad zhi: rtswa legs: lhas la gtor na god kha chad de phyugs 'phel bar 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa byad 'grol gyi cho ga dngos la/ rnam pa gsal gdab bgegs gtor gtang*// 'byung bzhi nyon mongs dug sbyang zhing*// byad 'grol me lhar byad thag 'bul// sngags chus 'khru zhing me la 'gong*// gdan brje byab rdzas gsum gyis byab/ khrus dngos gzungs ring chen mo dang*// gzungs thung bzla zhing bum chus 'khru// srung 'khor bde legs shis brjod brgyad// ces pa'i dang po bsgrub bya gsal gdab cing bgegs gtor gtong ba ni/ de yang byad 'grol ba'i gzhi ni khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum yin la/ gang 'grol bar bya ba ni/ ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad kyis bcings pa/ 'grol byed ni gdams pa zab mo 'dis so// de yang 'grol bya'i rnam pa gsal 'debs tsam yin pas 'di ltar sgoms mdzod/ da lta khyed rang pha rol gyi byad khas bcings te yod pa'i tshul du lcags khang gru gsum par tshud cing*/ sbrul sngo dmar gyis bcings pa dang*/

mchod rten nag pos mnan pas 'khyog 'gul mi shes par mnan pa'i tshul mdzod/ de yang byad 'grol bar byed pa la/ spyir mthun rkyen thams cad la bar du gcod cing mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ngan thams cad kyi sna 'dren pa ni bgegs yin pas/ de la gtor ma sbyin nas bskrad par bya ba yin te/ bgegs gtor bshams la bsang chu bran nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon du byin gyis brlab/ bgegs rnams/ oṃ badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa bkug / sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams skyong byed pa'i// lha klu gnod sbyin nam mkha' lding*// dri za srin po mi 'am ci// 'byung po gdon bgegs lan chags rnams// gtor ma mar me mtheb kyu dang*// changs bu glud bzang 'di khyer la// tshe sngon mnar ba'i lan chags dang*// rkyen gyur glo bur 'tshe ba rnams/ khro rgyal chen po'i bka' bzhin du// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// lan chags bu lon sha mkhon byang*// 'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri na// lho phyogs gshin thang nag po na// gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yis// las kyi dkar nag chos bshad kyi/ khyod kyi chos skal de ru nyon// mi 'gro slar yang gnod sems na/ khro rgyal 'bar ba rab khros nas// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog/ gtor ma phyir bskyal/ drag sngags a+yai ring dang hūm̐ bzhi bzla zhing thun brab pa dang gu gul gyis bgegs bskrad/ gnyis pa phyi 'byung bzhi'i byad spyir 'grol ba ni/ khyed rang gi lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa yin la/ de la phyi rol gyi 'byung ba'i dwangs ma rnams kyi stobs su smin na mthun rkyen byed la/ gshed du babs na 'gal rkyen byed de/ de yang pha rol pos las sbyor byed pa'i mtha' 'byung ba bzhi gang rung la gtad pa las mi 'da' bas/ de'i nyes pa sbyong ba'i phyir 'byung ba'i dug spyir sbyong ba ste/

hūm̐/ rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas// sku gsum ting 'dzin las grub pa'i// sngags pa las kyi nus stobs kyis// gnyen po'i lha srung bskyed pa bcas// phrin las pho nya'i cho 'phrul gyis// lha sngags ting 'dzin drag po'i rdzas// lo zla gza' skar dus tshod dang*// rgyu dus thebs zlog sa bdag dang*// gdong thug gtad bcug nyes pa dang*// stong nyid nam mkha'i dmigs sbyor gyis// sa yi 'og tu mnan pa dang*// 'byung ba chu la gtad pa dang*// drag po'i sbyin sreg me yi las// phra men rlung la bskor ba dang*// dgra gshed nang 'khrugs sbyor ba yis// rang gis phar byas log pa rnams// rdzas sngags nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ces 'byung ba'i dug spyir sbyangs nas/ de nas 'byung ba so so'i khyad par du byad 'grol ba ni/ slob dpon gyis sa thogs la/ pha rol gyis 'byung ba sa la mnan pa byas pas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon sa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sa ni sra mkhregs rang bzhin te// nyon mongs zhe sdang thams cad sbyongs// me long ye shes gsal gyur cig /laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ chu thogs la/ 'byung ba chu la gtad pas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon chu la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ chu ni brlan zhing gsher ba ste// nyon mongs nga rgyal thams cad sbyongs// mnyam nyid ye shes gsal gyur cig /baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ dpal 'bar thogs la/ 'byung ba me la sbyin sreg byas pas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon te me la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me ni tsha zhing sreg pa ste// nyon mongs 'dod chags thams cad sbyongs// sor rtog ye shes gsal gyur cig /raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ rlung g.yab thogs la/ 'byung ba rlung la 'khor lo bskor bas byad du gyur pa thams cad khyed rang gi lus las thon rlung la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rlung ni yang zhing g.yo ba ste// nyon mongs phrag dog thams cad sbyongs// bya grub ye shes gsal gyur cig /yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ me long thogs la/ stong nyid nam mkha'i dmigs sbyor gyis bcings pas byad du gyur pa thams cad dmigs med nam mkha'i rang bzhin du dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nam mkha' kun khyab rang bzhin can// nyon mongs gti mug thams cad sbyongs// chos dbyings ye shes gsal gyur cig /e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ des phyi 'byung ba lnga'i dug sbyong ba song*/ de nas nang nyon mongs lnga'i byad 'grol ba ni/ de yang dper na khab len gyi rdos lcags sdud pa bzhin khyed rang gi rgyud la las nyon gyi sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i phyir byad kha sogs 'gal rkyen thams cad shugs la 'du bas sdig sgrib sbyong ba gal che/ des na khyed rang tha mal du gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de ltar gsal btab nas tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bshags pa dang*/ phyin chad mi bgyid snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan pos yig brgya dang snying po 'di nyid bzlas pas sku las byung ba'i byang sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis sdig sgrib thams cad nag 'dur gyis sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs dang*/ bdun dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ nyer gcig tsam bya ba phyag len/ ces ci nus su bzlas nas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad mthol zhing bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes de ltar mos gdung gis gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa byad 'grol zhing byad thag dmigs byar gsal ba me lhar 'bul ba ni/ gri lcags las grub pa'i chu gri ra rog 'og can gyi rwas yu ba byas pa thogs la/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor du gsal ba'i phyag na ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba bsnams pas khyed rang gi lus la bcings pa'i byad thag bcad pas bcings pa'i nyes pa thams cad las grol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid khro rgyal gtsug tor gyis// phyag na ye shes ral gri bsnams// tshe sngon las ngan las grub pa'i// nad dang gdon dang rig sngags byad// pha rol mi dang mi min gyis// dngos su bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// lkog tu bsam pa dug g.yos dang*// phra men gtad khrom 'gong chog dang*/ khang sel zhing sel dud rlung dang*// hom dang par bu bskor ba dang*// byad du bcug cing ngag mnan pa// mi mthun sbyor ba'i dug rnams kun// gcod byed ral gri me 'bar bas// thams cad dum bur gtubs nas kyang*// ye shes me lha'i zhal du 'bul// sho dang khram la btab pa rnams// gnam lcags ral gri 'bar bas bcad// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas bcad/

sku */ oṃ kā ya k+ṣa ya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+wam+bha ya byer: dz+waṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: gsung*/ āḥwāk k+ṣa ya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+wam+bha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: thugs/ hūm̐ tsit+ta k+ṣa ya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+wam+bha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: snying po/ tad+ya thā: oṃ a na le a na le: bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe: bhai ra bhai ra: badz+ra dhā ra ṇi: bhan+dha bhan+dha ni: badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: hūm̐ drūṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa swā hā: zhes bzla bzhin par byad thag 'grol zhing bcad do// de nas dmigs bya me lhar 'bul ba la thab dang me lha gsal btab pa ni/ lcags slang la sogs pa'i snod du skyer shing sogs drag po'i shing gi hom gru gsum du brtsigs nas mdun du bshams la/ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing me sbar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me gsos nas/ a mṛta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i// drag po'i thab khung gru gsum mtshan nyid kun// yongs rdzogs nang du raṃ las bskal pa'i me// 'bar dbus pad nyir mthing nag yi ge hūm̐// de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas mchod// phas rgol rig sngags dmod pa'i sbyor ba bshigs// byin rlabs dngos grub dwangs bcud hūm̐ la thim// de nyid yongs gyur pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// me lha khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can// dbu stong rtsa zhal nyis brgya mthing nag rngam// g.yas zhal nyis brgya gser mdog 'dzum nyams rgyas// rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po chags pa'i nyams// g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang gu gtum pa'i tshul// steng zhal nyis brgya dkar po bzhad pa'i zhal// stong phrag phyag ldan bye ba phrag brgya'i spyan// dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu blta// rdzi smin ag tshom dmar ser me ltar 'bar// zhal gdangs ya so hūm̐ las khro bo bcu// ma so hrīḥlas khro mo bcu ru gtsigs// mgrin pa nyi zla lce ni gcod byed kyi// rno ngar ral gri 'bar ba'i rnam par gdengs// stong phrag phyag na gnam lcags ral gri bsnams// thod skam dbu rgyan zhing glang stod g.yogs dang*// stag sham mgo phreng dur khrod rgyan chas brjid// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor thabs drag por bgrad// gar dgu'i nyams rgyas dbang sngon lhun po la// nyi ma stong gis 'khyud bzhin gzi brjid 'bar// bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs// de yi spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar po// mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥ

snying gar nyi dkyil hūm̐ sngon mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs bskul// spyan drangs yi ge gsum la thim pa yis// rim bzhin rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin// snang mtha' dmar po g.yas pa pad+ma 'dzin// mi bskyod mthing ga g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin// kun kyang g.yon pa dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas// mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar sku gsung thugs byin brlabs// de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gyur// spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las// ye shes sgyu mar rol zhing gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes mchod/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rnam rol las// rig sngags dmod pa phyir zlog drag po'i lhar// rnam rol rdo rje khrag 'thung gtsug tor can// 'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod cing*/ byad thag bcad pa dmigs rten du bcas la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/

chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas pha rol rig sngags mkhan gyi byad phur rbod gtong bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi nus pa thams cad dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig / snying po'i mthar/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod/ khro rgyal 'khor bcas gnam sa lta bu'i zhal// gdangs nas gnod byed thams cad gsol bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsams nas/ byad thag 'bul tshig dang bstun nas rim bzhin mer 'bul/ sde brgyad byad thag bcad nas kyang*// drag po me lha'i zhal du gsol// yungs zor mtshe zor dz+wa la raṃ// gshin rje'i 'khor lo dz+wa la raṃ// gza' yi king kang dz+wa la raṃ// gnod sbyin gdug rtsub dz+wa la raṃ// lha chad rdo 'beb dz+wa la raṃ// mu stegs bar chad dz+wa la raṃ// ma mo'i khrag zor dz+wa la raṃ// bdud kyi khram 'debs dz+wa la raṃ// rgyal po'i thog rgyug dz+wa la raṃ// srin po'i za res dz+wa la raṃ// ltas ngan brgyad cu dz+wa la raṃ// ye 'drog sum brgya dz+wa la raṃ// bram zes tshe rku dz+wa la raṃ// bdud kyi 'thibs non dz+wa la raṃ// ban+de'i sngags zor dz+wa la raṃ// bon po'i dzo dmar dz+wa la raṃ// sho la thebs na sho kha sgyur/ khram la btab na khram kha phyis// gdon bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// ma rungs gdug pa tshar bcad nas// drag po'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul// zhes brjod cing lhag ma ma lus par 'bul lo// de nas me lhar mchod bstod byas nas/ ye shes pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar bar gyur/ bzhi pa byad 'khru zhing me la 'gong bas byad phur bsreg pa ni/ las sbyor gyi sngags chu sgro gzhob can gyi bum chu thogs la/ de yang sngags kyis bkol ba'i chu 'di nyid kyis khyod rang gi spyi bo nas blugs pas thog mar spyi bo'i gnon byed kyi mchod rten de bye ma'i mkhar chus bshigs bzhin sbyangs nas/

mthar khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs pas dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dag cing gtsang bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thog mar bum chus kha bshal nas phyir dor/ de nas khong du gtang*/ slar spyi bo nas blugs bzhin par sāts+tsha nyid bshig par bya'o// hūm̐/ dkon mchog bden pa'i thugs rje dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags mthu// rten 'brel rdzas kyi sbyor ba yis// rnam dag lha yi chu rgyun dang*// rmad byung ye shes bdud rtsi 'dis// las dang nyon mongs bag chags dang*// nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus 'khru// pho rgyud rnams kyi che btsan pa// dbang phyug chen pos bcings pa 'khru// mo rgyud rnams kyi che btsan pa// u ma de wīs bcings pa 'khru// dgra srog 'khor los gcod pa'i phyir// gshin rje yab yum bcings pa 'khru// ma tshogs dgra la dbab pa'i phyir// srid pa'i rgyal mos bcings pa 'khru// gsang sngags bstan pa srung mdzad ma// sngags srung chen mos bcings pa 'khru// dgra la bdud dmag dbab mdzad pa'i// bdud nag yab yum bcings pa 'khru// ltas ngan cho 'phrul mnga' bdag ste// rgyal po rnams kyis bcings pa 'khru// smyo 'bog cho 'phrul mnga' bdag ste// srog bdag tshangs pas bcings pa 'khru// sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i// dgra lhas bcings pa thams cad 'khru// dgra snying zas su za mdzad pa'i// rak+sha glog phreng bcings pa 'khru// dgra khrag skom du 'thung mdzad pa'i// sbal mgo khrag mig bcings pa 'khru// dgra snying zas su rol mdzad pa'i// yak+sha me dbal bcings pa 'khru// bstan pa'i bar chad sgrol mdzad pa'i// ma hā kā las bcings pa 'khru// dam las 'das pa sgrol mdzad pa'i// ru dras bcings pa thams cad 'khru// dgra sdang khram la dbab mdzad pa'i// dmu yis bcings pa thams cad 'khru// log lta bar chad 'dul mdzad pa'i// gu lang nag pos bcings pa 'khru// bar chad 'gong po 'dul mdzad pa// lha rabs sham pos bcings pa 'khru// mngon shes gtan la dbab mdzad pa'i// thog gi bu yug bcings pa 'khru// zas nor dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// the'u rang rnams kyis bcings pa 'khru// dgra la gri 'thab gtong mdzad pa'i// btsan rgod rnams kyis bcings pa 'khru// dgra la phung brdal gtong mdzad pa'i// bi nā ya kas bcings pa 'khru// dgra la phung gsum gtong mdzad pa'i// yam shud dmar pos bcings pa 'khru// dgra bo thun gyis gsod mdzad pa'i// mgyogs byed nag mos bcings pa 'khru// dgra la klu nad gtong ba'i phyir// klu bdud mgo dgus bcings pa 'khru// dgra la mdze nad gtong ba'i phyir// yak+sha nag mos bcings pa 'khru// de la sogs te lha srin gyi// gtad khram mnan gzer thams cad 'khru// phyi khrus dung las dkar ba dang*// nang khrus mchong las dmar gyur cig

k+ṣa ya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+waṃ bha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: hūm̐ tsit+ta k+ṣa ya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ me la phan tshun du lan bdun 'gom pa'i tshe ye shes kyi me lces khyed rang gi lus la gnas pa'i byad kha/ phur kha/ chag che/ nyam nga thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sku gsung thugs sngags dang snying po bzla zhing*/ bsgrub bya me la lan bdun 'gom du bcug me la mchong pa tsam gyis byad dang gtad khram las grol bar bsam mo// de nas re ba'i gdan dor/ gdan dkar por 'bru tshom bkod pa'i khar bzhag go / lnga pa byab rdzas rim pa gsum gyis byab pa las/ byab rdzas dang pos byab pa ni/ ba lu spe'u lcug ma rma bya'i mdongs rnams rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/ 'o byab rdzas 'di nyid kyis khyed rang gi lus la byab pa tsam gyis byad phur nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbur ma rlung gis bsdus pa ltar phyags nas me la sprugs te rjes med du bsregs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi can gyi shing bu 'di// bal bu bu yi tshul du byas// spe 'u shing gi ma mtshan te// ma yi rang bzhin dag tu byas// ma bu bsdebs pa'i lcug ma la// mdangs ldan rma bya'i sgro yis brgyan// grib dang nad gdon rig sngags byad// pha rol rbod gtong drag po dang*// gtad sel rlung gi sbyor ngan pa// phra men cho 'phrul ngan pa sogs// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa yis// nyes skyon log pa'i sbyor ba rnams// me long phyis bzhin byang gyur cig

byab tshig dang bstun par me'i steng du phyags tshul bya/ steng phyogs lha yis bcings pa byab// shar phyogs dri zas bcings pa byab// shar lho me lhas bcings pa byab// lho phyogs gshin rjes bcings pa byab// lho nub srin pos bcings pa byab// nub phyogs chu lhas bcings pa byab// nub byang rlung lhas bcings pa byab// byang phyogs gnod sbyin bcings pa byab// byang shar dbang ldan bcings pa byab// 'og phyogs klu dbang bcings pa byab// byabs pas thams cad byang gyur cig /gdon bgegs log 'dren 'byung po rnams// don la smra bsam brjod med yin// rang sems 'pho 'gyur bral ba 'di// 'khor 'das gnyis med chos kyi sku /chos nyid rang so zin gyur cig / sku gsung thugs sngags dang snying po brjod do// byabs rdzas gnyis pas byabs pa ni/ sngar bzhin byab rdzas 'om bu ku sha 'jag ma thogs la dmigs pa spod/ hūm̐/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma 'om bu'i shing*// thabs kyi rang bzhin tshul du byas// ku sha byang chub skyed pa'i gdan// 'jag ma shes rab rang bzhin te// thabs shes tshul du byas pa 'dis// de ring 'dir tshogs 'khor bcas kyi// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// srog lus dbang thang klung rta la// lha srin sde brgyad gdong thug dang*// gtad khram gdon dang mi gtsang grib// glo bur ye 'drog mi mthun byab/ sngar bzhin me'i steng du phyags tshul bya/ gshin rjes bcings pa thams cad byab// ma mos bcings pa thams cad byab// bdud kyis bcings pa thams cad= gnod sbyin bcings pa= gza' yis bcings pa= rgyal pos bcings pa= btsan gyis bcings pa= klu yis bcings pa= dmu yis bcings pa= rdo rje legs pas bcings pa byab// byabs pas nyes tshogs 'dzin rtog zhi// zung 'jug sku bzhi mngon gyur shog / sku gsung thugs sngags dang snying po brjod/ slob dpon gyi phyag tu mda' dar thogs la/

byab rdzas gsum pa mda' dar gyis byab pa ni/ de yang mda' la btags pa'i dar tshon lnga po 'di nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku ru gsal ba'i so so'i sku las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i tshul du 'phros/ khyed rang gi rgyud la gnas pa'i dug lnga'i nyes tshogs thams cad sbyangs nas ye shes lngar rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ snyug ma chos nyid stong pa la// sgro ni sku gsung thugs kyi mda'// ltong ni thabs dang shes rab tshul// mde'u chos sku nyag gcig rtags// rten 'brel thabs kyi mda' bzang la// shes rab stong gsal me long brgyan// ye shes lnga mtshon dar gyis spras// mda' dar mthing ga rnam snang gsal// nyon mongs gti mug thams cad byab// chos dbyings ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar dkar po rdor sems gsal// nyon mongs zhe sdang thams cad byab// me long ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar ser po rin 'byung gsal// nyon mongs nga rgyal thams cad byab// mnyam nyid ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar dmar po snang mtha' yas// nyon mongs 'dod chags thams cad byab// sor rtog ye shes gsal gyur cig /mda' dar ljang gu don grub gsal// nyon mongs phrag dog thams cad byab// bya grub ye shes gsal gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal phrag dog las gyur rnams// rtogs na ye shes rang bzhin yin// ma rtogs dug lnga rang rgyud pa// dug lnga'i rang mdangs dgra bgegs rnams// ye shes lnga ru lhun grub nas// chos nyid rang sa zin gyur cig /

sku gsung thugs sngags dang snying po brjod/ drug pa khrus dngos ni/ thog mar rten byin rlabs can gyi snang brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol te/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe sangs rgyas sku bltams tshe// brgya byin la sogs lha rnams dang*// bkra shis lha mos glur bcas nas// dag pa'i sku khrus gsol pa bzhin// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam sbyong ba// ye shes chen po'i khrus byas pas// dug lnga'i rang rgyud rnam sbyangs nas// ye shes lnga ru lhun grub shog /srab 'jam kha dog rnam legs pa// dri bzang snying po rab bkod pas// rnam rtog yid kyi gzugs can phyi// ma rig 'khrul pa dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ dar dkar pos phyi ba'i tshul bya/ khrus chu de slar yang bum par blugs la/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor du gsal ba'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu bos gang ba'i khrus gsol ba tsam gyis/ byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong sdeb gshor rlung 'khor dbye bskrad rmongs pa sogs kyis bskyed pa'i nad gdon chag che nyam nga la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum chu/ slob dpon gyis gzungs rnams brjod cing las rdor gyis bum chu bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas blugs nas 'khru ba phyag len no/ rgyun mi chad par spyi bo nas blug cing lus thams cad 'khru'o// gzungs ring chen mo ni/ rgya gar skad du: bha ra u sha tsakra nā ma: bod skad du: ngag 'grol ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba: rdo rje gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo: phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo: dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo: spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum mnga' ba:
